description: Read or set where a project's generated material is kept. With project_id only: read. 'cloud' keeps it in FilmLab's private storage (default). 'lokal' and 'server' keep it private until publication: FilmLab only parks each new file for pickup, the local FilmLab bridge (DaVinci Resolve panel, FilmLab Drop for Final Cut Pro, Avid and Premiere Pro, or filmlab_abholen in the local bridge MCP) stores it on this computer ('lokal') or the studio's shared storage such as a NAS or Avid NEXIS ('server'), checks it and confirms. FilmLab keeps a private working copy (never public, signed access only) so export, sound mix and chains keep working, and deletes it when the project is closed with abschliessen: true, or when the period ends. Use 'lokal' or 'server' whenever the person wants generated material to stay off the cloud until release. The change applies to material generated from now on. abschliessen: true (only after the person confirms the project is finished or published) deletes all working copies at FilmLab; it is refused while files are still waiting for pickup unless auch_offene: true, which deletes those for good. The answer carries speicherort, privat, offen (files still waiting for pickup), arbeitskopien (copies FilmLab still holds), abholfrist_tage (after that, working copies are deleted) and a sentence to pass on.

abschliessen.description: true: the project is finished — delete all of FilmLab's working copies. Ask the person first

auch_offene.description: With abschliessen: also delete files that were never picked up (they are then gone for good)

speicherort.description: 'cloud', 'lokal' (this computer) or 'server' (studio storage). Omit to only read
